rows.en: There's no mistake! These are Vol cells.

Vol cells…?

No, that's strange…?

I know plenty about prokaryotic cells, mainly bacteria, and the eukaryotic cells found in higher animals…

but I've never heard of anything called Vol cells.
Vol cells are supposed to be what turns the Fusion Steel we carry into a perfect biological weapon.
A perfect biological weapon?

Our Fusion Steel is a prokaryotic cell with a cell-adhesion function.

Its adhesion factor acts on the human body, which is made of eukaryotic cells, fusing with it, and that completes the Fusion Steel's attachment.

But because of differences in cytoplasmic factors between the Fusion Steel and the human body, communication between those cells is still far from perfect…

Then… you're saying Vol cells act on the receptors of both cell types to improve the signaling?

In other words… they serve to fully connect the prokaryotic cells and the eukaryotic cells? Is that it?

As expected of you, Mr. Hongo…

That's exactly right! Vol cells are a type of archaeal cell.
Archaeal cells!?
You know about them, Hongo?

It's said that only three kinds of cells exist on this Earth…

prokaryotic cells, eukaryotic cells… and archaeal cells.

They're called that because they've stayed adapted to Earth's primitive environment, so to speak… Their defining trait is that they live in extreme environments.
Extreme environments?

Some species use hydrogen sulfide as a source of nutrients and live in places at 85 to 100 degrees Celsius…

Truly extraordinary organisms…
Hydrogen sulfide is a deadly poison, isn't it? And they feed on that?
Yes… They're organisms you'd hardly believe come from this Earth.
And that's what these Vol cells are?
And… this is the Gigants' nest! Let's go!!

At first, Dr. Hinata thought it was a single-celled organism with the ability to move… a kind of slime mold.

But no matter where he looked, he couldn't find a cell nucleus… So he revised his thinking and announced that Vol cells were a type of prokaryotic cell.

However, there was just one thing the doctor simply couldn't explain…

As you know, a cell has three functional parts: the cell surface, the cytoplasm and the nucleus.

The surface protects the cell from its environment, passes information gained from it to the cytoplasm, and also handles movement…

The cytoplasm functions as a production unit, making the compounds needed based on that information.

And the nucleus is what controls all of it.

But when Vol cells, which should be a type of prokaryotic cell with no nucleus, fuse with a higher animal such as a human…

the nucleus of that eukaryotic cell stops responding entirely.
Meaning…?
The cells are hijacked.
C-Could something like that really happen?

Yes…

Closer to home, the Gigants we've been fighting are a prime example…
Those things… are human?

Not necessarily…

But what's certain is that they were almost surely higher animals with eukaryotic cells.
No… I can hardly believe it. That such a creature existed on this Earth…

That's the problem…

To call it a creature of Earth…

No, it would be simpler to call it an extraterrestrial life form.
You can't mean…!?
For example… the recent Jimmy Kitahara incident.
The case where bacteria and other microorganisms clinging to the hull of the escape pod we rescued and recovered were brought to Earth?

That's right…

That time, the TDF's science group pooled all its strength to develop a sterilization system and succeeded in rendering those space bacteria harmless…

But even that is just one page in the long history since the Earth was born.
So you're saying it has happened in the past, of course, and could happen again in the future?

Unfortunately…

the power of our science… no, the power of mankind itself, is truly helpless in this vast universe.
That's exactly why… people value their limited lives and strive to live them to the fullest.
Isn't it precisely because life is limited that people love and are loved, help one another, and try to seize happiness?

Heh heh heh… Welcome home, Lucifard!

But… unfortunately, you are not welcome here!

Apfaron!!

Wake up! Atefarina… no, Ryoko is dead! She's dead!

Apfaron!!

Wake up! Atefarina… no, Ryoko is dead! She's dead!

That's a pity…

So, shall I shed a tear or two and bid her remains farewell? Or perhaps… go into mourning and call a truce for a while?
What!?

The answer is NO!

Because… the one who defeated Atefarina was you, Lucifard…

Before the sworn enemy who killed my sister, there is only one answer!

Revenge, and nothing else!!
Kuh… Bring it on! Here I come, Apfaron!
Kuh… Bring it on! Here I come, Apfaron!
Lucifard! I, your brother, will see you off to your end…
I-Impossible… Fusion Steel, defeated!?

No… There's no way my Fusion Steel could lose…

But… destroying this space fortress is impossible… You will all… d-die in despair… in the midst of despair…

Heh heh heh… Hah hah hah!!

Apfaron… Ryoma!!

Damn it… Father… Steel Emperor Zephas! I won't forgive you, I won't forgiiive youuu!!

Apfaron… Ryoma!!

Damn it… Father… Steel Emperor Zephas! I won't forgive you, I won't forgiiive youuu!!
My brother was right… This is getting us nowhere!! There's no way but to destroy the power reactor.
My brother was right… This is getting us nowhere!! There's no way but to destroy the power reactor.
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But how!?
But what do we do!?
But what do we do!?
But what on earth do we do!?
But what on earth do we do!?
But how on earth!?
But how on earth!?
Somewhere there should be a control panel for accessing this space fortress's mother computer!
Somewhere there should be a control panel for accessing this space fortress's mother computer!
Please wait!!
Please wait!!
[HERO4]… what are you going to do?
[HERO4]… what are you going to do?
I'm going to shut down the Dimensional Distortion Field inside the Space Fortress Naager!
I'm going to shut down the Dimensional Distortion Field inside the Space Fortress Naager!
What…? Shut down the Dimensional Distortion Field?
What…? Shut down the Dimensional Distortion Field?

If we shut down the Dimensional Distortion Field, the Space Fortress Naager will be just like any ordinary spaceship…

The way to the power reactor should open up too!

Access code "SS0321/42"… Protection released!

This is the access code Lady Ryoko entrusted to me at the very end! Logging in to the Space Fortress Naager's mother computer!

Account name: "Ryoko Sakomizu". Password: "××××[HERO4]". Domain name: "NO-0117-A". Connecting…!

uncertain: U14025-U14038: pseudo-biology translated literally; 西細胞間の受吝体 read as 両細胞間の受容体.
U14060: 姉弟殺し rendered 'the one who killed my sister' (Apfaron speaking as the elder brother of both).

U14095/U14096: HERO4 speaks formally and calls Atefarina リョウコ様 ('Lady Ryoko'), suggesting she now carries Atefarina's memories; 迫水リョウコ rendered 'Ryoko Sakomizu' (family name from 迫水キイチ). The ［］ brackets around the code changed to double quotes.
U14098: 再起動 rendered 'Rebooting!' though the intent may be 'restart' of the system.
